summary: iter173 — Backend /api/me/ui-prefs (9/9 pytest PASS). Web Feature A (FUUSIC Dream AI + Ask expert + Get AI reflection + expert CTA + advisors switch) fully verified. Mobile Feature A + regression (dreams default tab) verified. CRITICAL: Web Feature B (Move-player toggle) is only implemented in AppShellB (classic_b variant). The default+enforced variant is new_look_v2 (AppShellV2), whose player dock is 'nlv2-player-dock' and has NO player-dock-toggle/menu. App.js:441-445 forces every non-admin to new_look_v2 on cold load (before user resolves, so even admins get flipped back to new_look_v2). Result: player-dock-toggle is unreachable for real users, and Feature B UI is effectively dead code.

ui_bugs.issue: The player-dock-toggle + player-dock-menu (5 options: bottom/top/left/right/float) exist only in /app/frontend/src/shell/AppShellB.jsx (classic_b variant). The active shell for all real users is AppShellV2 (new_look_v2) which renders only a fixed 'nlv2-player-dock' bar with no Move control. persistent-player testid is not present in AppShellV2 either.

integration_issues.issue: App.js (AppRouter useEffect at lines 441-445) forces designVariant=new_look_v2 whenever user is null OR non-admin. Because user is null on initial render, even admins are flipped to new_look_v2 before their /auth/me resolves; subsequent effect run finds variant already at new_look_v2 and does not restore classic_b. Net effect: /?design=classic_b is unreachable in practice, and Feature B (only wired in AppShellB) cannot be exercised by any user.

parity_issues.issue: Feature B is desktop-web-only per spec; mobile keeps its native bottom player. That is expected. Web side is broken because the movable player is wired to a non-default shell (AppShellB) that is unreachable.
parity_issues.expected: Web desktop persistent-player exposes player-dock-toggle with 5 options and persists via /api/me/ui-prefs
parity_issues.actual: Default shell (AppShellV2) has no such control; classic_b is force-reset to new_look_v2 on cold load

action_items: Move the DockMenu + PersistentPlayer dock props into AppShellV2.jsx (or lift the dock component and consume it from BOTH shells) so player-dock-toggle exists on the default variant.
Ensure the default player container in AppShellV2 renders with data-testid='persistent-player' and data-dock={dock}; adapt its position styles (bottom/top/left/right/float) same as AppShellB.
Adjust main content padding in AppShellV2 based on dock (so the player doesn't cover content in bottom/top modes).

Alternative if intentional: fix the App.js variant guard so classic_b remains selectable for admins (only enforce when user.role check is complete — currently the guard fires with user===null and permanently flips the store).

Manual retest after the fix: on demo@bigfm.dubai (non-admin) at 1920x800, click player-dock-toggle, verify all 5 options change persistent-player[data-dock], reload -> stays on chosen dock (persisted via /api/me/ui-prefs).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/me/ui-prefs is clean, idempotent and correctly returns HTTPException {code:invalid_player_dock} with 400 for unknown values.
usePlayerDock.js correctly sync-writes localStorage + PUTs the account; safe fallback on failed GET.
Feature-parity flaw: dock UI is only in AppShellB while the app's default shell is AppShellV2 — this is the root cause of Feature B being invisible.

success_rate.frontend: 66% (web A pass, web B unreachable, mobile A + regression pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Once Feature B is wired into AppShellV2 (or the variant guard is loosened), rerun the desktop 1920x800 dock flow: for each of {top,left,right,float,bottom} assert persistent-player[data-dock] changes and its bounding box matches the expected region; reload after 'float' to confirm the account persists it. Backend regression is in /app/backend/tests/test_iter173_ui_prefs.py.
rca of the issue: Root cause: DockMenu / PersistentPlayer(dock) was only added to the classic_b shell (/app/frontend/src/shell/AppShellB.jsx). The production/default shell is /app/frontend/src/design_v2/AppShellV2.jsx (rendered when designVariant='new_look_v2', which App.js hard-locks all non-admin users to via useEffect at lines 441-445; the guard also fires with user===null on cold load, causing even admins to be flipped to new_look_v2 before /auth/me resolves). Since AppShellV2 renders only a fixed 'nlv2-player-dock' with no dock toggle nor a persistent-player testid, the entire Move-player feature is dead code in the live app. Mitigation: hoist the dock UI into AppShellV2 (or a shared wrapper) and render persistent-player[data-testid][data-dock] there; keep usePlayerDock() as the single source of truth. Verified backend and Feature A + mobile regression are unaffected.
